quotes.quote: MEWC: Internal benchmark. Built on MEWC (Microsoft Excel World Championship), comprising 179 problems from the main and other regional divisions of Excel esports competitions from 2021–2026.
It evaluates the model's ability to understand competition Excel spreadsheets and use Excel tools to complete problems.
Scores are calculated by comparing output and answer cell values one by one.
2026.2.12 MiniMax M2.5: Built for Real-World Productivity.

GDPval-MM: Internal benchmark. Based on the open-source GDPval test set, using a custom agentic evaluation framework where an LLM-as-a-judge performs pairwise win/tie/loss judgments on complete trajectories.

Finance Modeling: Internal benchmark. Primarily contains financial modeling problems constructed by industry experts, involving end-to-end research and analysis tasks performed via Excel tools. Each problem is scored using expert-designed rubrics. Final results are averaged over 3 runs.

SWE benchmark: SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench Multilingual, SWE-bench-pro, and Multi-SWE-bench were tested on internal infrastructure using Claude Code as the scaffolding, with the default system prompt overridden, and results averaged over 4 runs.
Office work M2.5 was trained to produce truly deliverable outputs in office scenarios.
MEWC: Internal benchmark. Built on MEWC (Microsoft Excel World Championship), comprising 179 problems from the main and other regional divisions of Excel esports competitions from 2021–2026.
Scores are calculated by comparing output and answer cell values one by one.
Excel Esports is a competition where participants solve unusual game tasks in Microsoft Excel.
No finance, just Microsoft Excel and logical thinking skills.
A total of 256 players qualify for the Microsoft Excel World Championship 2026 Group Stage through a combination of Excel Esports Battles, the Qualification Round, and organizer wildcards.
There are 9 Road to Las Vegas online battles throughout the year.
12 players from each battle qualify to participate in the MEWC 2026 Group Stage
In order to provide fair ground for selecting the remaining participants to take part in the Group Stage of the tournament, a Qualification Round will be arranged on Saturday, September 26, 2026.
140 players will qualify for the Group Stage
The Group Stage will be a double-elimination all-vs-all format (all 8 groups will follow this Group Stage format), split across two dates
The MEWC 2026 Finals will be held in Las Vegas at the HyperX Arena, Luxor Hotel, from November 30 to December 2.
The Last Chance Qualification Round is open to every player in Las Vegas, including anyone eliminated earlier in the season.
The Quarterfinals feature 97 players from every path of the season
Players compete in two 30-minute games, with scores combined. The top 15 advance to the Semifinals.
The Semifinals feature 24 players
Every 5 minutes, the lowest-ranked player is eliminated.
The Final follows the same elimination format over 40 minutes.
